title: oreopteris elwesii
intro: Oreopteris elwesii, commonly known as Elwes' Fern or Golden Scaled Fern, is a species of fern native to the Himalayas and parts of Asia. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Oreopteris elwesii include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
